name: jaa minimal
description: ATS-first single-column CV: large name, contact details on one line, ruled section headings, each entry's dates flush right of its title. TeX Gyre Heros, 10pt, A4 (US Letter: one class option). For most applications.
license: MIT (this repository). Uses only packages and fonts from standard TeX distributions: titlesec, needspace, etoolbox (LPPL) and TeX Gyre Heros (GUST Font License).
